what: one join of a ring of 90 straight cylinder segments, each overlapping its neighbour at a 4 degree joint: a caught truck panic, then a refusal after 21 minutes
method: the segments (diameter 5, 7.6 long, centred on radius 100, every 4 degrees) overlap their neighbours (the 4 degree chord at radius 100 is 6.98 < 7.6), so they join into one closed ring: one body with one shell, valid. The joint overlaps have no simple closed form, so no volume is graded. The rig's timeout bounds the time (the issue expects time to grow about linearly with the segment count)
